title: A Supervisor with auto_delegate takes the supervisor's turns in the room it is installed in: its first pass, the supervisor's own turn with the task-formulation instruction after its prompt, turns the message into a task, which the team runs (here in parallel, each worker in a child room), then its second pass answers the message from the workers' results, handed to it in place of the message; only that answer is the room's, one deeper than the message
notes: Python: tests/test_supervisor.py TestSupervisorInstall::test_install_auto_delegate_wraps_on_event, TestTwoPassDelegate::test_two_pass_runs_workers, TestAutoDelegate::test_sync_auto_delegate_with_refine, TestTwoPassDelegate::test_two_pass_restores_prompt_on_error (the instruction rides one turn's binding copy); tests/orchestration/test_strategy_supervisor.py test_the_supervisors_turns_answer_at_the_depth_of_its_event[two_pass]. orchestration/strategies/supervisor/_install_auto.py _DelegatingTurns, delegate.py _two_pass_delegate, _formulate_task (TURN_INSTRUCTION), _build_pass1_instruction, _results_event, results.py _present_worker_results; channels/_ai_context.py with_turn_instruction. auto_delegate needs a strategy; refine_task is true by default. A parallel team's child rooms are created side by side: the RFC gives no order of their creation, so their records are matched as $created in either order.
